notablePrerequisites: You control at least four enchantments.
description:
Activate Lotus Field by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}
Activate Derevi by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Derevi enters the battlefield, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Derevi.
Resolve the Derevi trigger, untapping Lotus Field.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may untap any other permanent(s) using Derevi.
